subject: prd/impl-review
statement: When the host persistence adapter accepts one completed aggregate for a review-process attempt, it shall publish exactly one schema-valid artifact under an idempotency identity bound to the caller's review obligation, the review process, publication attempt, proposal, and revision, return that artifact's exact native receipt, and expose exact-read by that receipt; a retry after an indeterminate acknowledgement shall return the same receipt or remain non-accepting, never create a second completed-report artifact. The native receipt shall identify the medium object and shall never stand in for the distinct non-secret reference to protected launched-attempt proof.
rationale: artifact location and producer proof answer different questions; exactly-once observable publication prevents retries from manufacturing competing evidence
fit_criterion: GitHub and Carina fixtures cover success, concurrent duplicate calls, response loss after write, retry, and exact-read; each publication attempt produces one native artifact and one stable medium locator, duplicate bodies or proposal-wide matches never substitute for the receipted object, an indeterminate result stays non-accepting, receipt/proof substitution fails, and every hosted attempt preserves FR-35's reciprocal join
